'''Darth Gorgos''' was a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="Codex" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> who served on the ruling [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sometime after<ref name="Codex" /> [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' places the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> Gorgos commissioned the [[Spires of Victory]], a sculpture in [[Kaas City]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], in celebration of the Empire's victory over the Republic during the [[Great Galactic War]]. However, Gorgos was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by her [[Darth Gorgos's apprentice|apprentice]] before the sculpture was completed.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Gorgos was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Spires of Victory in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
